JURY TRIAL
Off Calendar Jun-14-2004 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: Matter comes on regularly for prove-up in Department 514. Present are Brenda Cruz Keith, counsel for plaintiff; also present plaintiff Kevin Simmonite; no appearance by defendant Renato Lozada. The Clerk telephones 931-4795 to reach defendant and leaves a message to have Mr. Lozada immediately call the court. No responsive call is received by the court.
Plaintiff Kevin Simmonite is sworn and testifies on his own behalf.
Plaintiffs Exhibit 1 (Employment Agreement) and Exhibit 2 (3 day notice to quit) are marked for identification and admitted into evidence.
The Court awards judgment in favor of plaintiff Kevin Simmonite and against defendant Renato Lozada for possession of the premises located at 237 Leavenworth Street #201, San Francisco, CA 94102, plus holdover damages of $934.89 and costs in the sum of $228.30, for a total award of $1,163.10.
The exhibits are ordered withdrawn.
